## Why This Is Asked
This question tests multi-task integration (pose estimation, instance segmentation, and garment modeling) from monocular input under edge constraints, while evaluating understanding of on-device few-shot adaptation. Key challenges include handling occlusions in crowded scenes, generalizing to diverse clothing, and maintaining real-time performance.

- Monocular 3D pose estimation with instance segmentation in crowded environments
- Differentiable garment modeling for coarse mesh reconstruction
- On-device few-shot adaptation (5-shot) for unseen clothing styles
- Synthetic data generation with domain randomization for training
- Temporal consistency across frames and efficiency optimization for edge GPUs

const loss = w_seg * segmentationLoss(predMask, gtMask)
            + w_pose * poseLoss(predPose, gtPose)
            + w_garment * garmentLoss(predMesh, gtMesh)
            + w_adapt * adaptationLoss(featureExtractor, supportImages);
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a monocular 3D perception pipeline for live sports analytics under tight latency, with edge adaptation and multi-task objectives (ball trajectory + player poses). It also probes data strategy and robust evaluation in production-like streams.

## Key Concepts

- Monocular depth and world-coordinate mapping from video
- 6-DoF pose estimation of multiple agents near a dynamic object
- 5-shot on-device adaptation for camera rigs
- Temporal filtering and uncertainty estimation for robust tracking

## Code Example

// Example loss terms (pseudo)
loss = w_ball * L_ball_pose + w_traj * L_traj + w_player * L_player_pose
L_traj = MSE(ball_world_t, ball_world_t-1 + velocity*dt)
```
